facts.fact: The Office of the Data Protection Commissioner under Data Commissioner Immaculate Kassait is operating, per its own bulletin.
facts.system: Office of the Data Protection Commissioner

facts.fact: The ODPC marked five years of the Data Protection Act, 2019 at a 19 November 2024 conference, describing its implementation.
The Data Commissioner stated the ODPC has issued 68 determinations, 68 enforcement notices and 11 penalty notices under the Act, a cumulative count with no stated year.
